# Sage (Sage 100, Sage X3) — vendor facts

Checked 24 Sept 2026. [OFF] official, [THIRD] third-party, [NF] not found.

## Prices [OFF] — Sage France product and price guide dated 20 Oct 2025 (the 15 Jan 2026 guide returned 404 on 24 Sept 2026)
https://www.sage.com/fr-fr/-/media/files/sagedotcom/france/documents/pdf/conditions-generales/2025/guide-produits-et-tarifs_2025_10_20_sans_spc_v1.pdf
- Annual prices, three columns: right of use with Classic plan / Assistance & remote maintenance / Serenity.
- Sage 100 Comptabilité and Gestion commerciale — Essentials: 983 / 1,139 / 1,309 € first user; 156 / 185 / 214 € per additional user (2–4 users). Standard: 1,367 / 1,566 / 1,807 € first user.
- Sage 100 Entreprise — Standard: 2,035 / 2,334 / 2,690 € first user; Premium: 2,592 / 3,431 € first user.
- Sage X3: not in the guide — on quote [NF].
- **VOLATILE** — check the current guide.

## Deployment
- Sage 100: on-premise or Sage Partner Cloud (SPC) hosting [OFF, Sage KB 12 Mar 2026]; SPC runs on Azure [THIRD].
- Sage X3: SaaS, private cloud or on-premise, through partners [OFF].

## Versions and support
- Sage 100 [OFF, Sage KB 25 Jul 2025]: contracts for Sage 30 / Sage 100 i7 and V16 or earlier "no longer renewed after 30 November 2026"; all expire at the latest on 30 Nov 2027, after which the software is read-only. Only V11 and V12 maintained [THIRD].
- Sage X3 [OFF, KB 16 Apr 2026]: two releases per year since Nov 2022; 2026 R1 = 12.0.39. Lifecycle Current 6 months → Standard 12 → Extended 6 (24 months) [THIRD — official document behind login].

## Customisation [OFF]
- Sage 100: business objects (Objets Métiers) and specific SQL must be adapted for SPC.
- Sage X3: documented upgrade procedure to V12; overwriting the Seed folder "is not certified by Sage".

## France e-invoicing [OFF]
- Sage is a PA (listed 22 Dec 2025); included "at no extra cost" up to a monthly invoice cap, then pay-per-use.

## Quote traps
- Sage 100 on old versions (V16 or earlier, i7): contract end dates above — migration is not optional.
- Serenity vs Classic plan confusion; per-user pricing tiers; SPC hosting cost separate; specific developments (business objects, SQL) not re-validated for the target version or SPC.
